title: Here Am I, Send Me
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about a hand going up before the confidence arrives, and Beau the Brave is the Traveler who volunteers first and feels proud afterwards.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he’s ready and willing to help. In Beau’s world today: at preschool, the teacher asked, “Who can help pass out the snacks?” Some kids felt shy, but Beau’s hand shot up. “I can do it!” He carefully handed a snack to every friend, feeling proud to help. Just like Isaiah said, “Here am I, send me,” Beau bravely volunteered to help.
